description: The full record of one event occurrence (occurrence_id from search_events) in a hub of mygn.de (Hamburg, München, Oldenburg + Umland) and rundown.city (San Francisco): summary, start and end, venue with address and coordinates, price_text and price_known (false: price not known, do not assume free), age_min, audience, url (the organiser's page, for tickets and opening details), the link to this event's own page on our site or, without one, our hub page (share_url), brand, attribution_url (the hub page to cite as the source) and the next 20 other dates (siblings; siblings_truncated true when there are more). Internal fields (signals, series_kind, kind, title_override) only with verbose true. all_day true: spans the whole day. time_unknown true: starts_at is only a date anchor, never show 00:00. series_continues true: the listed dates stop only where our look-ahead stops, so it likely runs on; never say it ends after the last listed date.

occurrence_id.description: The occurrence_id of an item from search_events.

verbose.description: true adds the internal fields (curation score and flags, signals, series_kind, kind, long_running) that are left out by default.

name: get_event

Audience.description:
Audience verdict of one event: ``family`` and ``adults_only`` are true, false or
null (unsure), ``visitor_pick`` (0 to 1) how much a first-time visitor would be glad
to find it (a ranking hint, not a filter), ``family_p`` (0 to 1) the raw family
probability behind ``family``.

title: Get event details
